_doc: Les 12 reels d'octobre 2026, tous tirés des rushes FX3 de HYROX Rome (dossier Drive « PIERRE », 1cAaXJwg9h9zdO0I8VRVNdJX_xHONtU6v). Les numéros de clips renvoient à assets/hyrox/rushes_rome_2026.json, qui dit où en était Pierre dans la course à chaque clip (recalage sur le chrono officiel). Rushes en S-Log3 : appliquer la LUT SL3SG3Ctos709. 100p : ralenti x4 disponible. Les incrustations de temps viennent de assets/hyrox/hyrox_pierre-huiban_rome_2026.srt. Muets à l'export comme les stories ? Non : ce sont des reels, la musique se pose dans Instagram à la validation.

reels.montage: Ouvrir sur les dernières wall balls au ralenti, chrono incrusté qui défile jusqu'à 53:34, coupe nette sur la ligne, puis la réaction dans 7377. 20 à 25 s.
reels.legende:
The last seconds of our fastest race 🇮🇹

53:34 in Rome with @antoine_bhna. First in our age group, and a new best by more than a minute.

I still can't watch this without smiling ❤️

Thank you Antoine 🙏

#hyrox #hyroxrome #hyroxdoubles #roadtohongkong

reels.montage: Tout au ralenti 100p, son de la salle conservé en fond. Compteur de reps en incrustation si lisible, sinon le seul temps de station.
reels.legende:
Station eight. 100 wall balls. Legs completely empty.

3:22 in Rome, our best-ranked station of the day (10th of 292).

Nobody is fresh here. It's just about not stopping 🙏

How do you get through your last 30 reps? I read everything.

#hyrox #wallballs #hyroxrome #roadtohongkong

reels.montage: Uniquement la course à pied, du Run 3 au Run 8. Une incrustation par kilomètre avec son temps (SRT). Finir sur le total.
reels.legende:
Everyone films the stations. Nobody films the running.

But in HYROX, it's 8 kilometres. In Rome we ran them in 27:59, 18th of 292 teams.

That's where most of our progress this season came from 🙏

Runners or station people: which one are you?

#hyrox #hyroxrunning #hyroxrome #roadtohongkong

reels.montage: Ralenti 100p sur le tirage, plans serrés 70-200. Rythme calé sur la cadence de rame.
reels.legende:
1000 metres of rowing, halfway through the race.

4:00 in Rome, 37th of 292. Right in the middle of the race, when everything starts to hurt.

Do you push the row or do you recover on it?

#hyrox #rowing #hyroxrome #roadtohongkong

reels.montage: Tirage corde au ralenti, finir sur le traîneau qui passe la ligne.
reels.legende:
Sled pull, Rome. 2:53, 15th of 292.

Hand over hand, and the sled feels heavier every metre.

In doubles you split the work. Trusting the other person to take their share is half the race 🙏

#hyrox #sledpull #hyroxdoubles #roadtohongkong

reels.montage: Choisir les plans où Antoine et Pierre sont tous les deux dans le cadre. Portrait du binôme, pas de la performance.
reels.legende:
Doubles is not two people racing side by side. It's one team.

@antoine_bhna and I have won our age group in Rome and qualified for the World Championships twice. Rome was one more.

Thank you Antoine, for every metre ❤️

Tag the person you'd race doubles with 🙏

#hyrox #hyroxdoubles #teamwork #roadtohongkong

reels.montage: Aucune incrustation de chrono. L'émotion, le souffle, l'accolade. Garder le son réel si possible.
reels.legende:
The minutes after the finish line are my favourite part.

No clock, no plan. Just the two of us, completely empty, realising what we just did ❤️

This is what all the early sessions are for 🙏

#hyrox #hyroxrome #finishline #roadtohongkong

clips: un plan par station disponible, dans l'ordre de course : 7346, 7349, 7351, 7353, 7358, 7365, 7373, 7376, 7377
reels.montage: Coupe très rapide, un plan par moment de course, nom et temps incrustés (SRT). Finir sur 53:34.
reels.legende:
Rome in 30 seconds ⏱

8 km of running, 8 stations, 53:34 with @antoine_bhna.

The full breakdown, station by station, is in the carousel on my profile 🙏

#hyrox #hyroxrome #hyroxdoubles #roadtohongkong

clips: plans de course au choix, plutôt larges et lumineux
reels.montage: Reel texte : trois phrases du persona en incrustation sur les images de Rome. Le changement d'heure de la nuit est le prétexte.
incrustations: My sessions start in the dark anyway.
This race was built before sunrise.
reels.legende:
Clocks went back last night. My early sessions just got a bit darker 🌒

With a job and a family, early mornings are where the training happens. Rome was built there, one early session at a time.

When do you train? Morning, lunch or evening? I read everything 🙏

#hyrox #morningtraining #workingdad #roadtohongkong

reels.montage: Les transitions seulement : entrer, poser, ressortir. Chrono de roxzone qui s'additionne en incrustation jusqu'à 4:04.
reels.legende:
There's a ninth station in HYROX that nobody trains: the Roxzone.

In Rome we spent 4:04 in transitions. 25th of 292 teams.

That's free time to win back before Hong Kong 🙏

#hyrox #roxzone #hyroxtraining #roadtohongkong

clips: plans de course au choix, un par phrase
reels.montage: Reel manifeste, trois cartons au gabarit de la DA (papier, Fraunces) intercalés avec Rome. Texte tiré du persona, rien d'ajouté.
incrustations: Sport is not my full-time job.
reels.legende:
Father. Executive. Athlete.

Sport is not my full-time job. My training has to find its place between a family I care deeply about and a demanding job across France, Spain and Italy.

I share it because I think a lot of you live the same thing ❤️

#hyrox #workingdad #hybridathlete #roadtohongkong

reels.montage: Récap du mois en 20 s, finir sur un carton « 221 DAYS · HONG KONG ».
reels.legende:
221 days to Hong Kong 🇭🇰

October was about Rome. November is about the work: the sled push, the transitions, and a lot of early mornings.

Thank you for following the road. It means more than you think 🙏

#hyrox #roadtohongkong #hyroxworldchampionships #hybridathlete
